description: This file manages booking limits for a specific booker, including checking active bookings and handling rescheduling logic, with external dependencies for database access, logging, and error handling.

methods.name: checkActiveBookingsLimitForBooker
methods.description: Main exported function to check and enforce active booking limits for a given booker, optionally offering rescheduling.

methods.name: checkActiveBookingsLimit
methods.description: Checks the count of active bookings for a booker and throws an error if the limit is exceeded.

methods.name: checkActiveBookingsLimitAndOfferReschedule
methods.description: Checks active bookings with ordering, and if limit exceeded, throws an error with rescheduling details.
